subject: Next: qualification -> 3-week POC plan + owners
messages:
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>
To: Olivia Martin <olivia@atlasfinance.com>
Cc: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>, Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-05-02T14:12:00-07:00
Subject: Next: qualification -> 3-week POC plan + owners

Hi Olivia — thanks again for the call today. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we have a tight path to value for Atlas.

Highlights from our discovery
- Goal: automate expense classification and anomaly detection in near-real time (aim: reduce manual review by 60% on high-volume vendors).
- Key success criteria: 95% precision for top 10 vendor categories; alerts for anomalies with <5% false positive rate; end-to-end latency <500ms for classification requests at expected QPS.
- Data: you'll provision a 30-day sample feed (S3), plus a small superset for edge cases.
- Compliance ask: keep data in our US region; no PII to leave your VPC.

Proposed POC (3 weeks) — quick sketch
Week 0 (kickoff): access, NDA (we'll attach), and confirm sample data.
Week 1: baseline run on sample; model configuration and routing.
Week 2: integrate prefix caching + evaluation harness; start live shadow tests.
Week 3: consolidation, run acceptance tests against success criteria, and handoff doc + recommended production config.

Ownership (proposed)
- Atlas: Olivia (primary), Samir (engineer) — provide S3 feed and testing windows
- Redwood: Markus (AE) — commercial/contract, Dylan (CSM) — technical onboarding and acceptance gating, myself — program lead and exec updates

Action items (for our Monday kickoff):
1) Olivia: share S3 path and sample manifest by Monday EOD.
2) Samir: confirm an engineer for a 45-minute kickoff.
3) Redwood: we will send the POC outline and draft MSA addendum for triage.

Attachments: atlas-poc-outline.pdf (POC plan draft), NDA template.

If this aligns, I’ll schedule a 45-min kickoff for Monday 11:00am PT and drop the DocuSign link for the NDA/MSA addendum.

Thanks — Hannah

--
Hannah Schmitt
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
hannah_schmitt@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0192
From: Olivia Martin <olivia@atlasfinance.com>

Cc: Samir Patel <samir.patel@atlasfinance.com>
Date: 2027-05-03T09:10:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Next: qualification -> 3-week POC plan + owners

Thanks Hannah — this looks good and mirrors our goals. Quick confirmations: 
- Success criteria: agree on the top-10 vendor bucket focus for week 1, we'll provide a mapping file.
- Data: I can share an anonymized S3 sample by Monday; Samir will own the upload.
- Compliance: US-only processing is a hard requirement.

We can do Monday 11:00am PT for kickoff — Samir (cc) will be on the call. We'll need the NDA signed before we hand over the sample.

Also, one ask from procurement: can you confirm any data retention defaults for POC logs (we prefer 30 days)?

Olivia
Director of Data Ops
Atlas Finance

Markus / Dylan — copying over the public bits and a few internal asks before kickoff Monday 11:00am PT with Olivia and Samir.

Internal asks: 
- Dylan: lead on technical kickoff, own onboarding checklist, confirm we can enforce 30-day POC log retention (answer the procurement question). If there are config limits that require product or infra signoff, flag them now.

Thanks — want to be aligned so the kickoff is crisp.

From: Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.com>
To: Olivia Martin <olivia@atlasfinance.com>
Cc: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-05-04T08:30:00-07:00
Subject: Kickoff recap + quick questions (Atlas POC)

Hi Olivia/Samir — thanks for the kickoff earlier. Short recap and 3 small technical asks so we can start baseline runs on Tuesday: 

1) Sample manifest: we need a CSV with schema (transaction_id, vendor, amount, currency, timestamp, description). If you can mark ~2000 labeled rows for top-10 vendor categories that's ideal.
2) Access: please add poc-redwood@atlas-s3 to the bucket ACL with read-only for the sample path.
3) Retention: we enforce 30-day logs for POC by default and will delete after project completion; we will not persist PII. Confirm if 30 days is acceptable.

Next steps: once we have the sample we’ll run baseline inference and share a short report (expected 48 hours). Planning cadence: weekly 20-min syncs (Tuesdays 9:00am PT) and async daily notes in the shared Drive doc.

Attachments: none.

Thanks — Dylan
Principal Customer Success Manager, Redwood Inference
dylan_brooks@redwood.com
